note: spaces toolbar -- renders: Mail/Address Book/Calendar/Tasks/Chat/Settings/Collapse; except addon container (third-party extensions)
unified toolbar -- renders: search bar entry, search button, app menu button; fixed operator controls
main menu bar -- renders: File/Edit/View/Go/Message/Tasks/Help
chat toolbar -- renders: Add Buddy/Join Chat/Status Type/Chat Accounts buttons; except user-set status message label
chat placeholder title -- renders: fixed operator text shown when no chat account is configured
chat placeholder description -- renders: fixed operator help text
chat placeholder button -- renders: Open Account Wizard (fixed operator control)
folder pane header bar -- renders: More/Write Message/Get Messages buttons
thread pane header bar -- renders: Quick Filter toggle, Display options button; except folder name (user-namable) and message count container
message header action buttons -- renders: Reply/Forward/Archive/Junk/Trash/Other Actions/Star
status bar offline indicator -- renders: fixed online/offline status text
status bar text -- renders: operator-generated status messages (connection state, progress)
compose menu bar -- renders: File/Edit/View/Insert/Format/Options/Tasks/Help
compose toolbar -- renders: Send/Encryption/Spelling/Save/Contacts/Attach buttons
formatting toolbar -- renders: paragraph style, font face, font size, bold/italic/underline, list/indent, alignment, insert, smiley controls
extra address row buttons -- renders: CC/BCC show buttons and extra address rows menu button
compose header label -- renders: From (fixed operator vocabulary)
compose header label -- renders: To (fixed operator vocabulary)
compose header label -- renders: Subject (fixed operator vocabulary)
compose status bar -- renders: operator-generated status text
